logp.method_description: The log Po/w value of the complex [LIr] was calculated by a shake flask method using the previously published procedure.31 A known amount of each complex was suspended in water (prostrated with n-octanol) and shaken for 48 h on an orbital shaker. To allow the phase separation, the solution was centrifuged for 10 min at 3000 rpm. After the separation of two layers, analysis was performed by UV-vis spectroscopic technique. The partition coefficient (log Po/w) values were calculated using the OD of the complex in n-octanol and water.
